meta.notes: Permanent, append/update-only ledger. Never rebuilt from scratch. Weights: the original 6-domain system (see docs/readiness/scorecard-2026-07-30.md) combined booking/scheduling/crew into the Lead->Sale->Schedule domain at 20%. This ledger splits that into two domains per Jeff's explicit instruction; the 20% was split 12/8 (Lead->Sale->Schedule / Booking-Scheduling-Recurring) since sale-conversion is closer to the core revenue-engine framing than execution mechanics, and Jeff did not supply new weights for the 7-domain split. This is a judgment call, recorded here rather than silently assumed.
